caveat: Gene-set membership is real mouse annotation. Any assignment of these gene symbols to anonymous synthetic SIM identifiers is arbitrary demonstration metadata; all resulting enrichment values have no experimental biological interpretation.
library: GO Biological Process mouse; non-IEA; protein-coding projection
upstream_processing: MGI GAF native mouse annotations; exclude evidence IEA and ND and NOT-qualified records; resolve GO primary IDs; true-path propagation through is_a and part_of within biological_process namespace; retain upstream sets of 5–500 objects. Upstream release recorded in manifest; GO concept DOI is not a release-specific DOI.
local_processing: Resolve compact member indices through same-commit symbols.json. Intersect each set with its first codingN=26310 authoritative NCBI mouse protein-coding gene symbols, to exclude GAF complex objects and noncoding identifiers. Retain nonempty sets; GSEA must additionally apply min_size/max_size after intersection with ranked experimental universe.
identifier_type: Authoritative NCBI mouse protein-coding gene symbols at mirror build date
source_version_limitation: This collection is intentionally restricted upstream to terms of 5–500 GAF objects before local protein-coding projection; terms larger than 500 are absent even if an experimental-universe intersection could make them smaller. Refresh a complete versioned ontology/annotation snapshot for experimental analysis if needed.
